initialExam.title: RRB NTPC (Graduate Level) 2026
initialExam.description: Non-Technical Popular Categories exam for graduate level posts in Indian Railways including Station Master, Goods Guard, etc. CBT-1 result out 11 Jun 2026; Graduate CBT-2 on 10 Jul 2026.
initialExam.eligibility: Bachelor's Degree from a recognized University
initialExam.syllabus: CBT-1: Mathematics (30Q), General Intelligence & Reasoning (30Q), General Awareness (40Q). CBT-2: Same subjects with advanced level. CBAT/Typing for specific posts.
initialExam.examPattern: CBT-1: 100 questions, 100 marks, 90 min. CBT-2: 120 questions, 120 marks, 90 min.
initialExam.selectionProcess: CBT-1 → CBT-2 → CBAT/Typing → Document Verification → Medical
initialExam.jobRole: Station Master, Goods Guard, Senior Commercial cum Ticket Clerk, Traffic Assistant, etc.
initialExam.careerGrowth: Station Master → Station Superintendent → Divisional Operations Manager.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit rrbcdg.gov.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Upload documents 5. Pay fee 6. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Free Rail passes, Quarters, Medical, Pension
